name: GET /api/empi/candidate-links - query POSSIBLY_SAME links by confidence band
description: Queries probabilistic EMPI candidate links, filtered by confidence band (high|medium|low) or an explicit min/max score range, optionally narrowed by status (open|merged|rejected|superseded) and capped by limit. Edge cases: every query param is optional - an unfiltered call returns links across all bands; min/max arrive as strings and are parsed with parseFloat/parseInt, so non-numeric values become NaN and silently widen rather than 400; an unrecognised band or status is passed straight through to the query and simply matches nothing; no matches returns 200 with an empty array, never a 404; any query failure is caught and flattened to a bare 500 InternalError.

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in the form "Bearer <jwt>"
JWT signature invalid, malformed, or past its exp claim
the candidate-link query throws (bad band range, DB failure) — caught and returned as a bare InternalError

testCases.name: List candidate links in the high-confidence band
